ERR_PROV_FULL.message: No room for another connection: every slot is taken

ERR_PROV_SYSTEM.message: {link} {channel} belongs to the board and cannot be removed

ERR_PROV_TOO_LONG.message: {len} bytes are too long for {link} {channel} (at most {max})

ERR_PROV_BUSY.message: {link} {channel} is busy: its send queue is full
ERR_PROV_BUSY.hint: Send less often, or wait for the connection to catch up.
